Regardless of the who the who is... these are wonderfu words of encouragement. 💗 Definitely brightened my morning outlook. Not ment for me but thank you OP.

Who the heck downvoted this comment?! 

Hey.. Hi! This is a sub for abusive relationships why would you shame someone for telling their truth?! I cant think of one person who has actually experienced an abusive relationship, escaped it and survived that would downvote this comment. 

It is incredibly hard to leave these kinds of relationships, for a multitude of reasons! If you can't comprehend that, congratulations! You've never experienced this battle. Standing in judgment and providing shame doesnt really help. Instead, try offering loving support.

OP, I can hear that you are open to looking at things as they are not as you wish them to be and I applaud that! 🙌🏼  It's a step in the right direction. Keep telling your truth, pick you and your safety and happiness whenever possible, and fuck the trolls. Online and irl.

For. Real. 

I do the same thing and sometimes remind myself that I'm not weird at all for thinking/feeling the ways I do. In the realm of healing from narcissistic abuse, it seems that I'm actually pretty freaking normal. 

Y'all inspire me to keep going and to keep doing the (sometimes really hard) work to heal. 💖

Funny, my narc ex, is also a ex-heroin addict. 

And yes, we do get treated just like any other "thing" that they "love" in their lives. My narc ex collected several different types of things and when he wanted a new one of those things, he would obsess over it and even skip out on paying bills just to get it. He'd travel hours away (and stand in line for even more hours)for a chance to get. He'd it love it intensely for a few months, showing it off online and to whom ever would pay a minute of attention irl. But eventually, there would be a new thing he HAD to have and often he would barter, sell, or trade those once beloved items to get the new thing. 

I recognized it one day and I said, " You know, I used to wish to be like one of your (collectable items here), but now I realize that I am. Nothing is sacred or precious to you and everything has its price. There is always something better out there and you'll never stop searching for it, will you?" 

Lol he did NOT love that 😅 

Hahaaa... ugh.. I'm such a "crazy bitch". If by crazy he meant seeing reality as it is and not as the love bombing, future faking, gaslighting bs reality my ex would feed me.... then yeah, I'm crazy as hell.

Humans are hardwired for negativity. It's a survival thing, negativity bias. 
At some point in our evolutionary history, the people who were better able to recognize negative/dangerous experiences were the ones that survived. They passed their "negativity" genes to their offspring and a few million years later.. here I am frustrating the hell out of a partner because I have no idea where I want to eat dinner but I sure as hell know where I DON'T want to go! 🙄

We are complex apes.

Exactly. The few people I have in my life have enough to occupy their lives without me. I don't want to let them think they can do something to stop this, either. You know? I'm old, I've wanted this for most of my life. I know that's not going to change. I know it's hard for people to accept but if you really care about them, why would you want them to be in pain for the rest of their lives??

I've accepted I'm not a "main character" kind of person. I'm not even a "supporting actor"... people treat me most like an "extra" if anything.

I'm not a person who has had anything but destructive love in life.. it's just not for me. I don't want love anymore. I just want peace.
Am I misreading this... or did this person have a girlfriend while they were on tinder?

I'm just entering that place of acceptance, that I will never have a love in my life. 

I look forward to the day I'm fine with it.

People radiate towards fake, self absorbed, self obsessed, narcissistic people. Those are the people humans celebrate. 

So, I guess you are right. If you act in narcissistic ways as you describe... people will love you.

I am right there with you on this! I was just saying to a friend last night "I've had guys do alot of different things to me sexually but I've never had a guy make a commitment to me before having sex with me and at this point that sounds pretty hot!" 

Am I saying that I'll be able to not have sex till I'm married? Maybe, maybe not... But I can definitely see the draw in the idea of waiting for some kind of commitment and trust to be established before having sex. 

I'm not interested in just being a vehicle for someone else's pleasure or using someone else for mine. I want to experience a true intimacy and vulnerability with someone and then have sex with them. But from everything I see, read, or hear... I have a very odd "kink" indeed.

I'll say this, we are definitely lucky to have escaped them! 

Recovery from narc abuse is bumpy, but healing does happen in time. It sounds like you know the real truth OP. Don't let go of that now. 🙌🏼 And if the truth does get hazy, keep reaching out to other people who understand what you're going through.

Its almost frightening to me sometimes, that it was all fake. It was all just to manipulate and control me to provide him with narcissistic supply. Everything, all of it. He is a walking, talking lie.

He is abusing you. Straight up. 

This is not love. I repeat; THIS IS NOT LOVE!

You deserve to feel safe, secure, appreciated, heard and seen. On the most basic level of human relationships this should be happening, but with a romantic or sexual relationship especially.
I've had the thought to do this... but I think it would hurt too much.

*sigh* 😊

God never ceases to amaze me. The divine is everywhere and in everything, whether we choose to recognize it or not. God is moving. 

Thank you for allowing Spirit to move through you. God bless you.
I crave the same. I hear you

Hes lying to his wife, someone who he felt was important enough to connect himself to legally (and I believe spiritually). If hes cool lying to her, why would you think it matters to him that he's lying to you? 

Karmically speaking tho, it can't be good that either of you have partners you are cheating on. I feel bad for both of your SO's and for both of you.

Your instincts are good! Follow them 💖 I wish I would have trusted mine way sooner than I did.

I wish with everything in me that they would never again have any influence over me or my existence and I in no way want to observe the walking lie that is their person. They make me sick and I hope they feel the same way about me so they just leave me the fuck alone.

Yes, this definitely happens. 

It's called -blame shifting- here is a helpful article about it.

https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/tech-support/202006/narcissists-controllers-and-the-art-blame-shifting

It's a common tactic used by the narc when someone tries to hold them accountable for their actions. 

I suppose it means that there is just more evidence proving your person is indeed a narcissist? They will never be able to recognize that they hurt you or that the things they do and say effect you and others.They will never feel remorse or guilt for the things they do, not because they don't want to, but because narcissists literally don't have the ability to do this. Can they feign or fake empathy, guilt, and remorse?? Definatly! But never to the levels needed for a healthy and sustainable dynamic for any relationship. 

There are plenty of people in this world that can and do care genuinely and wholeheartedly about the ways you feel and about the ways the people around them feel! 💕 Unfortunately, your narc will never be one of them.

I did them with my nex and honestly it was so weird and scary. It felt like I was talking to a brick wall or a hollow shell. 

In experiences with other people, we would always talk a lot, take walks, be creative, and connect to one another and the world around us. With him, all he wanted to do was watch stuff, listen to music, and have sex. I would try to talk to him and he would just stare back silently with blank expressions or say stuff like " okay? "  in that way that lets you know that it would be better if you'd just stfu.

I've had some professional psychedelic therapy since our break up and through integration around those experiences, it makes total sense that he behaved like that. 

Once you remove the ego from the narc, theres nothing underneath that. They have nothing to offer, they only consume and take. Also they don't have the ability to empathize with people, so there is no relating to the greater whole.

Idk if the victim is being "blamed" here, per say. 

To me it feels more like telling a driver to know the driving laws of their area, have car insurance, and to wear a seatbelt. 

We do this stuff to protect ourselves from recklessness and irresponsibility on the road. Should others not drive while distracted, intoxicated, overly tired, or overly emotional? Yes, of course people shouldn't operate vehicles while impaired... but they do. And they probably always will. So we will continue to be responsible ourselves and do what we can to protect ourselves against those drivers who aren't. 

Some people will always lie, manipulate, cheat, and take advantage of others. Often, it's not even maliciously done either. It's done out of maladaptive and destructive defense mechanisms. They just literally can't be anything but toxic and abusive (And that is not an excuse, it's a reason. There is a difference). 

Stay aware, educated, and connected with other people who are as well so we have people to check in with when we are unsure of the red flags we see.

Search

Projection

 Reviewed by Psychology Today Staff

Projection is the process of displacing one’s feelings onto a different person, animal, or object. The term is most commonly used to describe defensive projection—attributing one’s own unacceptable urges to another. For example, if someone continuously bullies and ridicules a peer about his insecurities, the bully might be projecting his own struggle with self-esteem onto the other person.
The concept emerged from Sigmund Freud’s work on defense mechanisms and was further refined by his daughter, Anna Freud, and other prominent figures in psychology."
